        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    sepsR=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0]
    sepsC=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]!=0]
    R=ranges(sepsR,H); C=ranges(sepsC,W)
    out=[]
    for (r2,r3) in R:
        blocks=[]
        for (c2,c3) in C:
            b=[[g[r2+a][c2+b2] for b2 in range(c3-c2)] for a in range(r3-r2)]
            nz=[v for row in b for v in row if v!=0]
            col=set(nz)
            if col:
                blocks.append((b,len(nz),min(col)))
        # template: largest block; color: min of all colors present in band
        tmpl,_,_ = max(blocks,key=lambda x:(x[1],-x[0][0][0] if False else 0))
        cmin=min(x[2] for x in blocks)
        out_row=[[tmpl[a][b]*cmin if tmpl[a][b] else 0 for b in range(len(tmpl[0]))] for a in range(len(tmpl))]
        out_row=[[cmin if v else 0 for v in row] for row in out_row]
        out.append(out_row)
    return out

def analyze(band_in,band_out,label):
    H,W=len(band_in),len(band_in[0])
    c=comps_of(None,{(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if band_in[r][c]!=0})
    print(label,'comp sizes',sorted(len(cc) for cc in c))
    big=max(c,key=len)
    rel={(r-min(r for r,_ in big), c-min(c for _,c in big)) for r,c in big}
    print('bbox', min(r for r,_ in big),max(r for r,_ in big),min(c for _,c in big),max(c for _,c in big),'rel',sorted(rel))
    offs=[(ar,ac) for ar in range(H) for ac in range(W) if all(0<=ar+r<H and 0<=ac+c<W and band_out[ar+r][ac+c]!=0 for r,c in rel)]
    print('output offsets of template',offs)

            bcells=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if g[r][c]!=0]
            if not bcells: continue
            # comps inside band-block; take largest
            seen=set(); best=None
            for cell in bcells:

                st=[cell]; seen.add(cell); comp=set()
                while st:

                    for dr in(-1,0,1):

            rmin,cmin=min(rs),min(cs)
            rel={(r-rmin,c-cmin) for r,c in best}
            h=max(rs)-rmin+1; w=max(cs)-cmin+1
            col=min({g[r][c] for r,c in best})
            # anchor set: try all (ar,ac) in band interior
            good=[]

                    if ok: good.append((ar,ac))
            if not good: continue
